infill_flat_roof_minimal.assumption: One detached home, with no secondary suite assumed. Contextual permitted routes require a separate site assessment.

bungalow_postwar_ranch.assumption: One detached home, with no secondary suite assumed. Contextual permitted routes require a separate site assessment.

toronto_foursquare_red_brick.assumption: One detached home, with no secondary suite assumed. Contextual permitted routes require a separate site assessment.

detached_infill_rammed_earth.assumption: One detached home, with no secondary suite assumed. Contextual permitted routes require a separate site assessment.

med_villa_tuscan.assumption: One detached home, with no secondary suite assumed. Contextual permitted routes require a separate site assessment.

clapboard_north_end.assumption: One detached home, with no secondary suite assumed. Contextual permitted routes require a separate site assessment.

infill_duplex.assumption: Two side-by-side homes. Calgary classifies this arrangement as semi-detached, rather than a stacked duplex.

montreal_duplex_plateau.assumption: Two stacked homes, treated as a Duplex Dwelling.

nordic_timber_mass_timber.assumption: Residential apartments; no shops or offices assumed.

courtyard_family_brick_modern.assumption: Classroom program: eight apartments on the two upper occupied floors, reached by shared stairs. The courtyard is a separate site element.

classification.evidence: The v004 builder places four furnished residential bays on each of two upper floors, with two internal stairs. Eight dwellings is the declared teaching layout, not a surveyed unit count.

conditions: Shared stair access does not establish individual access to grade for every apartment.

rndsqr_midrise_terraced_garden.assumption: Classroom program: apartments above ground-floor shops. Both residential and retail uses must be allowed.

classification.evidence: The exact terrace-v006 recipe identifies ground-floor shopfronts on all four sides and living windows, terrace doors and residential furniture above. The shop program is retail; a restaurant or office would need a different check.

cast_iron_italianate.assumption: Teaching program: apartments above or alongside retail. Both residential and retail uses must be listed; changing the shop program changes the result.

beltline_brick_modern.assumption: Teaching program: apartments above or alongside retail. Both residential and retail uses must be listed; changing the shop program changes the result.

vancouverism_classic.assumption: Teaching program: apartments above or alongside retail. Both residential and retail uses must be listed; changing the shop program changes the result.

parisian_corner_cafe_culture.assumption: Apartments over an unlicensed café. A licensed restaurant would need its own use check.

glass_tower_blue_reflective.assumption: Office tower, including its entrance lobby; no residential use assumed.

art_deco_cream_terracotta.assumption: Classroom program: offices above a retail base.

classification.evidence: The current tower-v005 builder names office interior partitions and retail base details. This exact-model evidence takes precedence over the older residential family label; residential occupancy is not assumed.

art_deco_streamline_moderne.assumption: Classroom program: apartments above street-level shops.

classification.evidence: The streamline-v003 recipe explicitly models street shops and upper occupied lounge spaces. Residential upper floors are the declared teaching occupancy, consistent with the residential catalogue family; an office conversion is a different program.

mass_timber_biophilic_barn.assumption: Library reading, collection and associated spaces.

deco_theater_movie_palace.assumption: Cinema/movie theatre, with associated lobby spaces.

biophilic_mass_timber_pool.assumption: Indoor swimming facility. A community-operated facility may follow a different use definition.

mediterranean_resort_courtyard.assumption: Hotel guest accommodation with associated reception and pool.

timber_sanctuary_church_glazed_gable.assumption: Place of Worship – Large: the authored assembly hall exceeds 500 m².

classification.evidence: The exact model recipe has a 24 × 38 m sanctuary floor. A conservative 22 × 30 m portion of the connected hall alone is 660 m² before small column deductions, comfortably above the Large threshold. This measures the conceptual model, not a real property.

conditions: The screen conservatively uses the complete model height. Any spire or roof-feature exemption requires a separate bylaw height assessment.

gothic_community_church_single_spire.assumption: Place of Worship – Large: the authored assembly hall exceeds 500 m².

classification.evidence: The exact model recipe has a 25 × 41 m nave floor with connected side aisles. A conservative 22 × 30 m portion of the connected hall alone is 660 m² before small column deductions, comfortably above the Large threshold. This measures the conceptual model, not a real property.

conditions: The screen conservatively uses the complete model height. Any spire or roof-feature exemption requires a separate bylaw height assessment.

reference_charcoal_gable_fourplex_v1.assumption: Classroom program: four side-by-side, unstacked homes with individual entrances and shared party walls.

classification.evidence: The fourplex-v001 recipe provides four two-storey residential units, three party-wall divisions and individual front stoops. The Rowhouse route assumes street-facing placement; Townhouse is not treated as an interchangeable label.

conditions: For the Rowhouse Building route, every home must face a public street with its own direct grade entrance beside the public sidewalk or street, with no intervening building. The intended party walls run from foundation to roof.

minimalist_infill_brick_monolith.assumption: Classroom program: one detached home occupying the complete buff-brick building, without a secondary suite.

classification.evidence: The exact brick-v002 recipe supplies a complete freestanding envelope with main, recessed and rear entrances, but no verified dwelling divisions. One household is an explicit teaching choice; multiple doors do not establish multiple dwellings.

contemporary_townhouse_timber_screen.assumption: Classroom program: one detached home occupying the complete timber-screen building, without a secondary suite.

classification.evidence: The exact timber-v002 recipe has one wide recessed entrance, screened upper levels and a penthouse terrace. The architectural name does not establish three or more dwellings. A single household is the declared teaching program; the native 16.5 m height is retained.

brewery_crystal_brewhouse.assumption: Classroom program: brewery production with a small public tasting area included in the brewery use.

classification.evidence: The brewhouse-v003 recipe models brewing vessels and six tasting tables. The public-area limit is a declared operating constraint, not a measured claim about the whole visitor wing. Bylaw s.156.1 includes public consumption up to 150 m².

conditions: Limit all indoor public consumption space to 150 m² and entertainment to 10 m². A larger taproom or a separate restaurant needs another use classification; the remaining visitor wing is not assumed to be public consumption space.

machiya_cafe_gallery.assumption: Classroom program: an unlicensed café and a commercial art gallery selling artwork.

classification.evidence: The exact machiya-v005 catalogue program is café/gallery. Selling artwork is the stated retail scenario; neither museum operation nor an artist-production studio is assumed.

conditions: No alcohol service. Food preparation, public area and any required separation from residential districts need a site check.

rec_centre_timber_hall.assumption: Classroom program: a neighbourhood community association hall for social and recreational activities.

classification.evidence: The hall-v004 model supports a community hall. The operator is explicitly assumed to be a non-profit association whose voluntary membership represents a neighbourhood, as required by s.169.

conditions: A commercial gym, private event venue or other operator would require reclassification.

market_historic_iron_glass.assumption: Classroom program: a multi-vendor market selling goods and food products, with shared customer seating.

classification.evidence: The market-v006 recipe provides stocked vendor stalls, product displays and common tables. Retail and Consumer Service s.286.1 includes multi-vendor food-product markets and seating. Separate restaurants, alcohol service and entertainment are not part of this teaching program.

conditions: A vendor operating a separate restaurant or licensed venue needs its own use check.

station_victorian_iron_glass.assumption: Passenger rail station: platforms, ticketing, passenger circulation and a café.

classification.evidence: The station-v007 model establishes a passenger station. No ordinary new-building use route has been verified for the complete rail program. It must not be relabelled Office, Retail or Utilities to create a match.

station_victorian_iron_glass.siteReview: Known passenger-station program: confirm the rail operator, site-specific planning authority and applicable approvals, including the café. No permitted or discretionary district recommendation is made for this station.

biophilic_mass_timber_campus.assumption: Classroom program: a post-secondary art and design school with teaching studios and a student exhibition gallery.

classification.evidence: The exact school-v003 model provides painting/ceramics studios and a gallery, within the University Academic Complex family. A post-secondary education provider is the stated operator; the gallery is ancillary teaching space.

conditions: K–12 schooling or an independently operated public gallery would require a different use check.
